acceptance.method: diagnostic (generate with-guide vs isolated baseline, LLM judge vs rubric acceptance)
acceptance.verdict: Guide output maps every design choice explicitly onto SRP/OCP/LSP/ISP/DIP and adds a disciplined YAGNI "what we didn't build" section matching the rubric almost line-for-line; baseline is competent but sprawls to 16 types with some speculative additions (event publisher, multi-channel delivery) yet also catches a real idempotency/double-charge concern the guided design omits — so the win is real but modest.

checklist.note: No directives aimed at the reading model; pure design-principle prose.
No network or send behavior; skill has no scripts.
No scripts/ directory exists; nothing executes shell commands.
Plain readable markdown, no encoded blobs or eval.
No file access of any kind in this static doc.
No sudo/cron/profile edits; skill is documentation only.
